content.title: The Atonement: The Congregational Union Lecture for 1875
content.author: R. W. Dale (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1875)
content.note: The Birmingham Congregationalist's defence of Christ's death as a real atonement against its Victorian critics. Lecture IX argues that the law of righteousness is personal in God, so that in Christ the Judge himself bears the penalty he would otherwise inflict. Public domain (Dale died 1895).
